name: @red-cup-engineering/web-platform
description: The web platform app: fuses one web server (the resources) with one computer platform (the capabilities and their lifecycle), so every request runs over started capabilities, the platform drains before it releases, and a Workers deployment's bindings are that platform's providers. Downstream of web-server and computer-platform; upstream of web-application.

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
